name: Whispermouth
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. that delivers anonymous warnings through augment vibration patterns — a specific rhythm that street residents learn to recognize as 'leave now.'
observed_behavior: Monitors security communication channels and, when sweep operations are detected, triggers a distinctive haptic pattern in augments within the target zone.
story_hooks: The vibration pattern is traced to a specific Wishing Well member's heartbeat rhythm — the warnings are literally someone's pulse
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Pulse Carbine PC-6 'Heartbeat'
